partition: unchanged M01 subject groups: 26 train, 6 validation, 6 exposed regression participants

representations.features: training-only standardization then elementwise 0.9*z/(1+abs(z)); unchanged fifteen paired acoustic/EMG features
representations.waveform: per-window/channel centering and division by peak absolute centered value, times 0.9; no waveform clipping/imputation; absolute amplitude discarded

architectures.features: 15 features -> Dense16 ReLU6 -> Dense1 linear -> sigmoid
architectures.waveform: 4000x3 -> temporal Conv8 k5 s2 ReLU6 -> Conv16 k5 s2 ReLU6 -> global mean -> Dense16 ReLU6 -> Dense1 -> sigmoid

QAT: 8-bit fixed input [-1,1], bounded activations and pooling [0,6], logit fake-quant [-8,8], sigmoid [0,255/256]; per-axis conv weights and per-tensor dense weights; finetune from matched float warm start
checkpoint_selection: maximum validation event F1, tie lowest validation BCE; early stop after declared patience
selection: only eligible candidates; highest validation INT8 event F1, then lower max probability error, then smaller model bytes
parity_reference: dequantization-free FP32 shadow with the same trained kernels/biases; additionally report QAT simulation parity separately
test_usage: only selected candidate after frozen validation selection; original exposed regression only, not new confirmatory evidence
